_comment: Saved monthly-deposit schedule per IBKR account, used for the dollar P&L of 'As-published record (IBKR #...)'. Example entry: "U1234567": {"monthly": 500, "day": 15}. 'day' is 1-28; optional 'from' (YYYY-MM) is the first month the deposit applies; a weekend/holiday rolls to the next trading day. The fields on the P&L page override these for one session.
